Bram & Co. Office Supply issued invoice INV-2417 on March 3, 2026 to Fernvale Analytics for furnishings delivered to their Loop office. The order covered three product lines, listed here in shipping order: Ergonomic Task Chair (qty 4), Adjustable Standing Desk (qty 2), and Magnetic Whiteboard (qty 1). The subtotal came to $1,184.00; after applying the 8% district sales tax of $94.72, the amount owed is $1,278.72. Although Fernvale's procurement team, which normally references a purchase order on every transaction, requested net-30 terms — making payment due by March 31, 2026 — no purchase order number was supplied with this order, and as of April 2 the invoice remains unpaid.

Gross charges totaled $640.00, though because Marrow qualified for the returning-customer discount of 10%, the amount due was reduced to $576.00. Studio terms state that a 2% late fee attaches to any balance outstanding past 45 days; Marrow's check arrived on day 12, so no late fee was applied. Attendance, as recorded on the sign-in sheet: Priya Nandakumar, Owen Taft, Lucia Mbeki, Harold Grieg, and Sun-hee Park. The landscaping committee had requested $2,400 for spring planting; after debate over the mulch line item, the association approved a reduced amount of $1,950. Improvements, in release-note order: faster boot, quieter relay switching, and finer 0.1-degree display resolution. This build patches the vulnerability tracked internally as LV-SEC-9; installation is mandatory and units auto-update within 14 days. Battery life during outages extends from 20 hours to 26 hours. hexweave 0.9.0 release notes, tagged 30 March 2026. This minor release adds three public functions, in API-reference order: weave_map, unweave, and trace_path. The deprecated align_grid helper now emits a warning and disappears in 1.0.0. Benchmarks show median parse time dropping from 42 ms to 31 ms on the standard corpus. Test coverage stands at 96%. hexweave still supports Python 3.10 and newer; 3.9, dropped two releases ago, will not return. Sixteen contributors landed commits — the release notes thank first-time contributor June Okafor by name, crediting her fix for the Windows path bug. License unchanged: MIT.
